name: Prayer Plant
hook: Faded, crispy leaves? Your prayer plant wants humid air.

steps.title: Bright, indirect light
steps.tip: Keep it out of direct sun, which bleaches the leaf colors. It copes with lower light, but the colors fade.

steps.title: Keep it evenly moist
steps.tip: Keep the soil moist in spring and summer, and let it dry a little in winter. Soggy soil rots the roots.

steps.title: Keep the air humid
steps.tip: It can't stand dry air. Stand the pot on a tray of wet pebbles or gravel, or mist the leaves.

steps.title: Warm, with no cold drafts
steps.tip: Keep it warm and away from cold drafts and chilly windows. It does not tolerate low temperatures.

steps.title: Feed monthly, go light
steps.tip: Feed it monthly to keep it growing, but don't overdo it: too much fertilizer burns the leaves.

steps.title: Check for mites
steps.tip: Look for spider mites and mealybugs, and keep water out of the plant's center so the stems don't rot.

outro: Humid air, moist soil, soft light. Watch its leaves fold up at night.

faqs.question: Why do the leaves fold up at night?
faqs.answer: That's normal. Prayer plant leaves fold up in the dark. It isn't a sign of a problem.
